shots.emotional_purpose: 가사가 확인되기 전의 조용한 고백을 인물과 편지의 거리로 보여주는 도입 예시다.
shots.action_start: hero는 마이크 옆에서 접힌 편지를 왼손 허리 높이에 든 채 정면보다 약간 아래를 본다.
shots.action_end: hero는 한 번 숨을 고른 뒤 편지를 왼손 허리 높이에 그대로 유지하고 시선만 빈 객석 쪽으로 옮긴다.

camera.composition: hero and microphone in center foreground, piano rear left, lamp rear right
camera.focus: hero's face and folded letter while the background remains legible
camera.lens_intent: natural audience distance; no claim of a fixed focal length

shots.lighting: rear-right amber practical lamp is visible, a soft warm key shapes the left side of hero, and a faint cool rim comes from stage left over the charcoal curtain.
shots.film_look: AI-generated digital cinematic look with restrained simulated grain and gentle highlight roll-off; this is not a claim of physical film stock or lens control.

props.state: closed once-folded letter with the envelope hidden from view
props.screen_position: left hand at lower center, paper fold facing the camera

effects.choice: a very small amount of visible dust in the warm lamp beam
effects.purpose: give the quiet opening air without competing with the singer or the letter
effects.execution: post-production overlay only if the basic cut remains clear; no sound effect is implied

transition_out.purpose: move closer when the example musical section changes from hesitation to response
transition_out.execution: editorial cut after the last usable held frame

shots.emotional_purpose: 도입의 망설임 뒤에 시선이 올라가는 작은 결심을 가까운 관찰로 연결하는 예시다.
shots.action_start: hero는 접힌 편지를 왼손에 낮게 둔 채 렌즈 옆 빈 공간을 바라본다.
shots.action_end: hero는 편지를 가슴 가까이 유지하고 턱을 조금 들어 다음 구절을 시작할 준비를 한다.

camera.movement: almost locked frame with a short, slow push-in
camera.composition: hero occupies right-center, microphone stays in the foreground edge, warm lamp remains a rear-right cue
camera.focus: eyes first, then the lowered folded letter at the bottom of frame
camera.lens_intent: reduce audience distance while retaining the stage orientation; no claim of a fixed focal length

shots.lighting: the same rear-right amber practical and stage-left cool rim continue; the warmer key is slightly closer on hero's face while the room stays darker behind her.
shots.film_look: AI-generated digital cinematic look matched to shot-01 with restrained simulated grain; not physical film photography.

props.state: the same closed once-folded letter, lowered but visible at the lower frame edge
props.screen_position: lower center-left, fold direction unchanged from shot-01

effects.choice: no composited visual effect beyond continuity color correction
effects.purpose: keep the response phrase on the singer's expression rather than a spectacle
effects.execution: no VFX pass unless a verified continuity repair is required in post-production

transition_out.purpose: this illustrative eight-second plan ends on the held resolving look
transition_out.execution: retain the final clean frame for the editor; no transition is generated
